description: Solar photovoltaic annotations for computer vision related to the "Classification Training Dataset for Crop Types in Rwanda" drone imagery dataset is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Simiao Ren, Jordan Malof. This dataset contains annotations (i.e. polygons) for solar photovoltaic (PV) objects in the previously published dataset "Classification Training Dataset for Crop Types in Rwanda" published by RTI International (DOI: 10.34911/rdnt.r4p1fr [1]). These polygons are intended to enable the use of this dataset as a machine learning training dataset for solar PV identification in drone imagery. Coverage: national (RW); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 399474 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
